blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($β_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages, leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing the gains reverses the block-sparse advantage at 365M and removes 71-89% of it at 1.2B. We recommend reporting extension results at calibrated temperatures and checking that normalisation gains moved.
blocks.zh: 通常根据在默认温度下超过训练长度的密集基线,即1美元,判断培训时间的注意力变化。 其结果取决于基线的校准有多么错误:当它的对数被一个标尺磨净时,它恢复的复杂度的比例。 在标准配方(fp32主重)下,8k训练的基准量为8-15%,在3个种子派生365M双胞胎的30k时误判;在其中1个中,这使得块-sparse训练双胞胎看起来更好7%,校准可以去除. 在纯bf16没有主重的训练中,校准误差是数倍:在1.0分的增益上,AdamW步(+β_2 = 0.95美元)低于1.7\times10^{-3}美元最高学习率的bf16间隔的一半,因此增益从不移动(22个检查站),基线误差37-58%,挡板预训、注意力中断和ALiBi看起来好6-35%。 校准每个模型一个温度和长度可以消除所有三个优点,让ALIBI 5%落后于ROPE,并保留了正控,NTK-意识缩放的部分收益. 解冻收益逆转了365M的块状散射优势,并在1.2B上移除了其中的71-89%. 我们建议在经过校准的温度下报告扩展结果,并检查正常化收益是否移动。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Zero-shot context extension asks how a model trained at one sequence length behaves at a longer one. A training-time change to attention is usually judged by comparing it with a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default attention temperature, τ \tau = 1. That comparison has a hidden variable. Beyond the training length the softmax spreads attention over more keys than the logit scale was learned for, entropy rises, and sharpening the logits by one scalar recovers much of the loss ( Chiang and Cholak, 2022 ; Su, 2021 ; Peng et al., 2024 ; Nakanishi, 2025 ) . We call the relative perplexity drop from τ \tau = 1 to the best temperature the baseline’s miscalibration . A training-time change that merely tolerates τ \tau = 1 better than the baseline then looks as if it extrapolates, by up to the baseline’s miscalibration. This paper measures that confound under the standard training recipe (fp32 master weights, bf16 compute), shows that one precision setting makes it several times larger, and gives a check that removes it.
blocks.zh: 零镜头上下文扩展 问在一个序列长度上训练的模型如何在更长的序列长度下表现. 通常通过在默认关注温度下与训练长度以外的密集基线进行比较来判断训练时间对注意力的变化,\ tau=1. 这种比较有一个隐藏的变量。 除了训练时间以外,软马克斯在比所学的对数尺度更多的密钥上分散注意力, en升,用一个卡片磨磨对数,可以收回大部分损失(Chiang and Cholak, 2022;Su, 2021;Peng等人, 2024;Nakanishi, 2025)。 我们把相对的复杂度从\ tau = 1降至最佳温度, 训练时间的变化仅仅能容忍\tau = 1 优于基线,然后看似可以推断出基线的误差。 本文在标准训练配方(fp32主重,bf16计算)下错解的度量衡显示,一个精度设置使其大数倍,并给出了去除它的检查.

blocks.en: The vehicle is a set of seed-paired twins: a Dense model and a Mixed model that trains under random block-sparse attention masks and is otherwise identical (§3; the name refers to the mixture of mask budgets, not to mixed precision). Under the standard recipe, in three 365M pairs, the dense baseline is 8–15% miscalibrated at 30k, and in one pair that is enough for Mixed to look 7% better at 30k, although the two arms agree to within 0.03 log-perplexity once both are calibrated and Mixed is 2–3% worse within the training span (§4.4).
blocks.zh: 该车是一组种子派生双胞胎:一种Dense型车型和混合型车型,在随机的块状散射注意力罩下进行列车,在其他方面是完全相同的(§3;名称指面具预算的混合,而非混合精度). 根据标准配方,在三对365M对中,密度基线为8-15%,在30k时被误判,在一对中,混血儿在30k时看起来更好,只有7%,不过两只手臂在0.03对对齐和混血儿在训练期间更差2-3分(§4.4)。

blocks.en: In pure-bf16 training without fp32 master weights, the AdamW update to a normalisation gain initialised at 1.0 is smaller than half the bf16 spacing at any peak learning rate below about 1.7 × \times 10 -3 ( β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.95), so under round-to-nearest the gain never moves (§4.2). Every QK-normalisation gain in all 22 of our frozen-gain checkpoints (eleven Dense/Mixed pairs at 365M, 1.2B and 3B) is exactly 1.0, so neither arm could learn an attention logit scale. The baseline’s miscalibration at 30k is then 37% at 365M and 50–58% at 1.2B and 3B, and against it Mixed looks 6–31% better, ALiBi 35% better and, among the control arms we trained, attention dropout 8% better and fixed sparse masks 30–36% worse (§4.1). One calibrated temperature per model and length removes all of these advantages (ALiBi ends 5% behind RoPE) and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing only the QK gains removes most of the amplified effect: Mixed falls behind at 365M, 71–89% of its default advantage disappears at 1.2B, and ALiBi falls behind RoPE even at τ \tau = 1 (§4.3). The standard recipe improves both arms within the span but leaves the baseline more miscalibrated beyond it than the learnable-gain recipe does (§4.4). At seeds 42 and 43, the two trained under both recipes, the frozen-gain baseline’s miscalibration is three to five times the standard-recipe one in log-perplexity; why the frozen scale costs Dense more than Mixed is not identified.
blocks.zh: 在没有fp32主重的纯bf16训练中, AdamW更新到一个正态化的增益在1.0时小于任何峰值学习率低于1.7×x\时(β 2\beta_{2}=0.95)的bf16间距的一半,因此在回合对近时,增益从不移动(§4.2). 我们所有22个冷冻的检查站(365M、1.2B和3B的Eleven Dense/Mixed pairs)的QK正常化收益完全为1.0,因此两个臂都无法学习一个注意对数尺度。 基线在30k时的校准误差为365M时的37%,1.2B和3B时的50-58%,与之相反,混合型看起来好6-31%,阿利比35 %,在我们训练的管制武器中,注意力辍学率好8%,固定的稀有口罩30-36%(§4.1)。 每个模型和长度一个校准温度可以消除所有这些优点(ALiBi结束于RoPE之后5%),并保留正控,NTK-意识缩放的部分收益. 只解冻QK增益消除了大部分放大效应:混合在365M落后,其默认优势的71-89%在1.2B消失,而AliBi甚至在\tau=1(§4.3)时也落后于ROPE. 标准配方在跨度内改进了两只手臂,但比可学习的补方(第4.4节)使基线超出标准。 在42号种子和43号种子中,在两种食谱下训练的两人,冷冻回报基准的校准误差是对数的3到5倍于标准复刻的1倍;为什么冷冻尺度的成本 未识别出超过混合体的强度。

blocks.en: Our contributions are three. (i) A measurement of how much the default-temperature comparison misstates a training-time attention change, across eleven twin pairs, four control arms and ALiBi, with the three precision recipes placed on one scale (Table 3). (ii) A check, one calibrated temperature per model and length with a positive control and a stated resolution, that detects the confound under either recipe without knowing its cause. (iii) The bf16/AdamW freeze condition, its learning-rate threshold, and its reversal by retraining at two scales.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款是三笔。 (一) 衡量默认温度比较在多大程度上误报了11对双胞胎、4个控制臂和AliBi的训练时间注意力变化,并将三个精确的配方放在一个尺度上(表3)。 (二) 检查、每个模型的温度和长度进行校准,并有正控制,并有说明的分辨率,在不知晓其原因的情况下,检测出两种药方下出现的混乱。 (三) bf16/AdamW 冻结条件,其学习率阈值,并通过两个尺度的再培训来逆转.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Context extension and attention temperature. Positional interpolation ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , NTK-aware scaling ( bloc97, 2023 ; Peng et al., 2024 ) , LongRoPE ( Ding et al., 2024 ) and continued pretraining ( Xiong et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ) extend RoPE-based models ( Su et al., 2024 ) beyond their window; training-free methods remap positions or restrict attention at inference ( Han et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; An et al., 2024 ) . Several works identify softmax entropy growth with key count as a failure mode and scale the logits by a length-dependent factor ( Chiang and Cholak, 2022 ; Su, 2021 ; Peng et al., 2024 ; Nakanishi, 2025 ; Veličković et al., 2025 ) ; Wang et al. (2024) show that the length generalisation of a training-time change, NoPE ( Kazemnejad et al., 2023 ) , is governed by the attention temperature. None, to our knowledge, asks whether a training-time attention change can produce an apparent extension gain against a baseline that is merely miscalibrated, or how the training precision policy sets the size of that effect. Position-resolved evaluation is in the spirit of Liu et al. (2024) ; the seed-paired design is motivated by Dodge et al. (2020) and the significance tests follow Dror et al. (2018) .
blocks.zh: 上下文延伸和注意温度。 定位插值(Chen等人,2023年),NTK-aware缩放(Group97, 2023年;Peng等人,2024年),LongRoPE(Ding等人,2024年)和继续预训(Xiong等人,2024年;Fu等人,2024年)将基于ROPE的模型(Su等人,2024年)延伸至其窗口之外;无培训方法回映位置或限制对推论的关注(Han等人,2024年;Jin等人,2024年;An等人,2024年). 有几部作品将软马克斯 en生长确定为按键计数的失败模式,并以长度依赖因子对logits进行比对(蒋和乔拉克,2022年;苏,2021年;彭等人,2024年;中纳希,2025年;维利奇科维奇等人,2025年),王等人(2024年),显示训练时间变化的长度概括,NoPE(Kazemnejad等人,2023年),受注意温度支配. 据我们所知,没有人会问,培训时间的注意力变化能否比起一个仅仅是错误调整的基线产生明显的扩展收益,或者培训精确政策如何确定这种效果的规模。 定位解析评价符合刘等人(2024年)精神;种子解析设计受道奇等人(2020年)激励,意义测试依次为德罗等人(2018年).

blocks.en: Sparse attention. Fixed sparse patterns ( Child et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ) , content-based routing ( Kitaev et al., 2020 ; Roy et al., 2021 ) and natively trainable sparse architectures ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) train and deploy with the same operator; inference-time KV-cache sparsity compresses the cache of a dense-trained model ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024 ; Nawrot et al., 2026 ) . Our Mixed arm perturbs training with random block masks and budgets, like stochastic structural regularisers ( Fan et al., 2020 ; Huang et al., 2016 ) and randomised positional encodings ( Ruoss et al., 2023 ) , and is deployed here as an ordinary dense transformer. We use it only to measure the confound and do not propose it as a method.
blocks.zh: 注意点 固定稀疏模式(Child等人,2019年;Beltagy等人,2020年;Zaheer等人,2020年),基于内容的路由. (Kitaev等人,2020年;Roy等人,2021年)和本土可训练的稀疏建筑(袁等人,2025年;Lu等人,2025年;Gao等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年);推断时间KV-cache sparersity压缩了密集训练型号的缓存(肖等人,2024年;张等人,2023年;唐等人,2024年;Nawrot等人,2026年). 我们的混合臂扰动训练带有随机的块状口罩和预算,如Stochastic structural regulariser(Fan等人,2020年;Huang等人,2016年)和随机定位编码(Ruoss等人,2023年),并作为普通密集变压器部署在这里. 我们只用它来衡量困惑,而不把它作为一种方法。

blocks.en: Low-precision training. Training with an fp32 master copy of the weights is standard because updates below a parameter’s half-precision resolution are otherwise lost (shown for fp16 by Micikevicius et al., 2018 ); pure-bf16 training stalls parameters whose updates are small relative to their magnitude, which stochastic rounding or Kahan summation repair ( Zamirai et al., 2020 ) ; gains initialised at 1.0 are the most exposed. QK-normalisation ( Henry et al., 2020 ) bounds the attention logits and is used at scale with a learnable gain to prevent logit growth ( Dehghani et al., 2023 ; Wortsman et al., 2024 ) ; with the gain frozen at 1.0 the logits are capped at d \sqrt{d} and no multiplicative logit scale can be learned.
blocks.zh: 低精度训练. 使用fp32主拷贝的权重培训是标准的,因为低于参数半精度分辨率的更新会丢失(Micikevicius等人在fp16中显示,2018年);纯bf16培训摊位参数,其更新量相对于其规模较小,其变化性四舍五入或Kahan summation修补(Zamirai等人,2020年);收益在1.0时关闭是最暴露的. QK-正常化(Henry等人,2020年)将注意力对数限制在一定范围内,并使用可学习收益来防止对数增长(Dehghani等人,2023年;Wortsman等人,2024年);将收益冻结在1.0,对数上限为d\sqrt{d},无法学习多语言对数尺度.

blocks.en: 3 Setup
blocks.zh: 3 设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Models and training arms
blocks.zh: 3.1 型号和训练武器

blocks.en: All models are decoder-only transformers with RoPE (base θ \theta = 10 6 10^{6} ), grouped-query attention with QK-normalisation, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, tied embeddings and no dropout, with a Qwen3 tokeniser (vocabulary 151,936; Yang et al., 2025 ) and trained from scratch on 8,192-token FineWeb-Edu sequences (sample-100BT; Penedo et al., 2024 ; Appendix A) with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) at β 1 \beta_{1} = 0.9, β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.95, peak learning rate 5 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.01, 750 warm-up steps and cosine decay. The tiers are 365M (hidden 768, 28 layers, 44,000 steps, batch 20 sequences, 7.2B tokens; seeds 42–47), 1.2B (1,536, 28 layers, 50,462 steps, batch 60, 24.8B tokens; seeds 42, 70–72) and 3B (2,304, 36 layers, 100,000 steps, batch 60, 49.2B tokens; seed 42); unique parameter counts are 359M, 1.20B and 3.00B. Twins share the seed, optimiser, schedule, step count and data order; only the training attention mask differs. The Dense arm uses full causal attention at every step. In the Mixed arm each attention layer, at every step, draws one causal block mask from a fixed pool of 10,000 (block size 128; shared across the batch, independent across layers) that retains k of the 64 key blocks, k uniform over {63, 47, 31, 21, 11} (budgets 98–17%; Appendix A). At deployment a Mixed checkpoint is an ordinary dense transformer.
blocks.zh: 所有型号均采用ROPE(基座 \Theta = 10 6 10^{6}),以QK-常态化,SwiGLU, RMSNorm, 捆绑嵌入和不退出为主的编组-静态变压器,采用Qune3 代号器(vocabulary 151 936; Yang 等人,2025年),从零开始对8 192-toppen FineWeb-Edu序列(sample-100BT; Penedo 等人,2024年;附录A)与 AdamW(Loshchilov和Hutter,2019年)的组合式变压器进行训练,在β 1 \βa_{1} = 0.9,β 2\时间 10^{-4},重量衰减0.01,750个暖起步和共衰减. 等级为365M(隐藏768,28层,44000步,批20序,7.2B令牌;种子42-47),1.2B(1,536,28层,50,462步,批60,24.8B令牌;种子42,70-72)和3B(2,304,36层,10万步,60,49.2B令牌;种子42);独特的参数计数为359M,1.20B和3.00B. 双胞胎分享种子,选手,时间表,步数和数据顺序;只有训练注意力罩不同. Dense臂每一步都使用充分的因果关注. 在混合臂中,每个注意力层,每一步都从一个固定的池中抽取一个因果块罩(块大小128;分批共享,分层独立),保留64个关键块中的k,k制服超过{63、47、31、21、11}(预算98-17 %;附录A)。 在部署时,混合检查站是一个普通的密集变压器。

blocks.en: Three precision recipes are used (Table 3). Frozen gains : the eleven original twin pairs were trained in pure bf16, every parameter stored and updated in bf16 with bf16 optimiser state and no fp32 master copy, and their normalisation gains stayed exactly at 1.0 (§4.2); the appendix calls this the canonical recipe. Learnable gains : the same recipe with the 56 QK-normalisation gain tensors (the QK gains ) kept as fp32 master weights, cast to bf16 only in the forward pass; 365M seeds 42–44 and 1.2B seeds 70–72. Standard recipe : fp32 master weights and fp32 AdamW state for every parameter, bf16 compute; 365M seeds 41–43. Four 365M control arms at five or six seeds each (a static fixed mask, a resampled fixed mask, attention dropout, a scalar RoPE-distance control) and five ALiBi twins ( Press et al., 2022 ; distance biases replace RoPE, everything else as Dense) were trained with frozen gains; two further ALiBi twins (seeds 42, 43) were trained with learnable gains and are paired with the learnable-gain Dense of the same seed. Two single seed-42 365M regime pairs change one architectural setting with frozen gains (no QK-normalisation; RoPE base 10 4 ), and three single parameterisation ablations vary which gains can learn (all 113 normalisation gains; one learnable scalar per Q/K norm with the vectors frozen; RoPE base 10 4 with learnable QK gains); a Dense model trained natively at 16k is a training-time control (Appendix A). Later models were evaluated on other clusters, where the evaluator reproduces the original results to within 0.04% (Appendix B).
blocks.zh: 使用了三种精确的食谱(表3)。 冻结收益:11对原双胞胎在bf16中接受了纯bf16的训练,每个参数在bf16中存储和更新,具有bf16 optimiser状态,没有fp32主复制,它们的正常化收益完全停留在1.0(§4.2);附录称此为犬科食谱. 可学习的收益:与56QK规范化相同的配方获得的角数(QK收益)保持为fp32主重,只在前传中投到bf16;365M种子42-44和1.2B种子70-72. 标准食谱:fp32主重和fp32 AdamW状态每个参数,bf16计算;365M种子41–43. 4个365M控制臂,每颗种子5或6个(静态固定口罩、重印固定口罩、注意力中断、Scalar RoPE-距离控制)和5个Alibi双胞胎(Press等人,2022年;距离偏差取代RoPE,其他一切都是Dense)接受了冷冻增益训练;另外两个Alibi双胞胎(种子42,43)接受了可学习增益训练,并与同一种子的可学习增益双胞胎配对. 两个单一的种子-42 365M制对改变一个有冻结收益的建筑设置(没有QK-正常化;RoPE Base 10 4 ),三个单一参数化的拼音变化,可以学到收益(所有113个正常化收益;每个Q/K规范一个可学习的标尺,载体被冻结;ROPE Base 10 4,可学习的QK收益);在16k训练本土的Dense模型是一种训练时间控制(附录A)。 后来在其他集群上评价了模型,评价者将原始结果复制到0.04%以内(附录B)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Attention temperature and calibration
blocks.zh: 3.2 注意温度和校准

blocks.en: The attention temperature τ \tau divides the logits, q ​ k ⊤ / ( τ ​ d ) qk^{\top}/(\tau\sqrt{d}) , before the softmax; it is applied on the query side after QK-normalisation (which would otherwise absorb it), so τ \tau < 1 sharpens attention. “Calibrated” means one τ \tau (written τ ∗ \tau^{*} ) per model and evaluation length, selected on calibration windows by summed negative log-likelihood over three corpora from a 13-point grid {0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8, 0.85, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0, 1.1, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0} and applied to disjoint held-out windows, with the same grid for both arms. Because the temperature is selected at the evaluation length, the calibrated comparison is not zero-shot; we use it to diagnose the zero-shot one. §4.5 tests a data-free rule that needs no selection. Moving both arms one grid step together changes the 30k gap by up to 0.03 log-PPL (Appendix C.9). We therefore treat 0.03 as the resolution of the calibrated comparison: a residual inside it is not interpreted by size, only by the consistency of its sign across seeds and windows, and we call the arms “level” when that sign is not consistent. In-span means positions or lengths at or below the 8k training length, and Δ \Delta denotes log PPL(change) − - log PPL(Dense), where the change is Mixed unless stated otherwise (the control arms and ALiBi in Table 2); Δ \Delta = − - 0.10 means the changed model’s perplexity is 9.5% lower.

blocks.en: 4.2 The frozen normalisation gains
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 冻结的正常化收益

blocks.en: The frozen-gain baseline of §4.1 is miscalibrated because it could not learn a logit scale at all. In all 22 frozen-gain checkpoints every stored QK-normalisation gain value is exactly 1.0, and in the Dense-42 checkpoint all 113 normalisation-gain tensors are, the residual RMSNorm gains included (Appendix B). The gains had non-zero AdamW moments, so they were updated at every step, but each update rounded back to 1.0. The gains were stored and updated in bf16, whose spacing at 1.0 is 2 − 7 2^{-7} above and 2 − 8 2^{-8} below, so under round-to-nearest an update smaller than 2 − 9 ≈ 1.95 × 10 − 3 2^{-9}\approx 1.95\times 10^{-3} in magnitude leaves 1.0 unchanged. An AdamW update is η ​ m ^ / ( v ^ + ϵ ) \eta\,\hat{m}/(\sqrt{\hat{v}}+\epsilon) with bias-corrected moments, and by Cauchy–Schwarz | m ^ | / v ^ ≤ ( 1 − β 1 ) / ( 1 − β 2 ) ​ ( 1 − β 1 2 / β 2 ) |\hat{m}|/\sqrt{\hat{v}}\leq(1-\beta_{1})/\sqrt{(1-\beta_{2})(1-\beta_{1}^{2}/\beta_{2})} , which is 1.165 at β 1 \beta_{1} = 0.9, β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.95 (7.27 at β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.999; Appendix B). A gain at 1.0 therefore cannot move at any peak learning rate below 2 − 9 / 1.165 ≈ 1.7 × 10 − 3 2^{-9}/1.165\approx 1.7\times 10^{-3} (2.7 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} at β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.999); at our peak rate of 5 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} the largest possible step is 5.8 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} . fp32 master weights for the gains, or stochastic rounding, prevent the freeze at any learning rate, and the learnable-gain and standard-recipe checkpoints of §4.3–4.4 have 99% of their gain values more than one bf16 spacing away from 1.0. With unit gains after QK-normalisation the logits are capped at d \sqrt{d} , so a frozen-gain model cannot learn a multiplicative attention logit scale, the quantity a temperature corrects. Within the training span the freeze costs 2–5% in perplexity (Appendix C.4). Beyond it the freeze enlarges the miscalibration of §4.1: at 365M it is 37–39% with frozen gains and 2–4% once the QK gains can learn (§4.3).

blocks.en: 4.3 Unfreezing the gains
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 解冻收益

blocks.en: At 365M (seeds 42–44; Table 4) the gains moved. The mean QK gain is 1.31 in Dense and 1.41 in Mixed, and 99% of the values differ from 1.0 by more than the bf16 spacing. The mean product of query and key gains is 1.8 (Dense) and 2.1 (Mixed) times the frozen one and is frequency-selective, so the freeze prevented a per-dimension re-weighting as well as a scale (Appendix C.11). Dense’s 30k perplexity at τ \tau = 1 drops from 56–57 to 33–34, its miscalibration from 37–39% to 2–4%, and its rise across a 30k window from 4.5 × \times to 14% (Fig. 2a, dashed). Mixed is now behind at 30k at both temperatures (+0.042 at τ \tau = 1, +0.023 calibrated, 3 of 3 seeds, 36 of 36 windows in every seed, every position bin; Fig. 2b) and behind in-span too (+0.024 at 8k). At 8k the learnable-gain Dense is 2.6–4.6% better than its frozen twin.

blocks.en: The standard-recipe pairs (seeds 41–43; Table 4) test whether the confound needs pure-bf16 training. In-span they are the best 365M models in the study: Dense’s 8k perplexity is 29.2–29.7 against 31.3–31.8 with learnable QK gains and 32.7–32.8 with frozen gains. The 57 residual and final-norm gains, frozen in the other two recipes, settle at 0.86–0.89 on average, and the QK gains land where the learnable-gain recipe put them (Dense 1.28–1.30, Mixed 1.39–1.40; Appendix C.11). Beyond the span the baseline is more miscalibrated than with learnable QK gains alone: 8.6%, 8.2% and 14.7% at 30k (Table 4, rounded there), against 2–4% with learnable QK gains and 37–39% frozen. The miscalibration therefore does not require the freeze, although frozen gains make it several times larger.

In all three pairs Mixed is 2–3% worse in-span and level or behind calibrated at every length (Appendix C.5). Across recipes, Mixed is 2–3% worse than Dense in-span in the six three-seed 365M pairs, within about 1% in the 1.2B learnable-gain pairs, the 3B pair and the scalar-gain pair, and 0.5–4% worse in the remaining pairs. blocks.en: 4.5 The check
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 支票

blocks.en: The check has four parts. For each model and evaluation length, select one attention temperature on calibration windows and score held-out windows at it, with the same grid for every arm. Report the calibrated comparison next to the default one. State the resolution (here 0.03 log-PPL, one grid step) and read residuals inside it by sign consistency, not by size. Include a positive control, a change whose gain should survive, to show that the procedure does not also remove real gains; NTK-aware scaling plays that role here, with a calibrated gain of 3–4.5% at every tier and length. Applied without knowledge of the cause, the procedure closes the frozen-gain gaps (the RoPE-10 4 gap needs learnable gains as well) and exposes the seed-43 standard-recipe gain. With no per-arm search, the entropy-invariance rule τ \tau = ln(8,192)/ln(L) ( Su, 2021 ) applied to both arms lands within one grid step of the Dense selection and leaves | Δ \Delta | ≤ \leq 0.023 at one pair per tier, whereas YaRN’s sharper rule leaves Mixed 2–6% ahead (Appendix C.10). The check says nothing about which arm is better in-span or whether either arm uses the far context. After calibration the per-bin loss no longer falls as context accumulates (Appendix C.3), and perplexity on windows that cross document boundaries is an insensitive measure of long-range use ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Limitations).
blocks.zh: 支票有四个部分 对于每个模型和评价长度,在校准窗口上选择一个注意温度,并在它上评分被扣的窗口,每个手臂都有相同的网格. 报告默认位置旁边的校准比较 。 说明解析度(此处为0.03对数-PPL,一个网格步骤),并按符号一致性而不是大小读取其中的剩余部分。 包含一个积极的控制,一个其收益应该存在的改变,以表明该程序并不会消除真正的收益;NTK-意识的缩放在此发挥这一作用,在每一级别和长度上校准3–4.5%的收益. 该程序在不知晓原因的情况下应用,从而填补了冻损的空隙(RoPE-10 4空隙也需要学习收益),并暴露了43种子标准折合收益. 在不进行每件武器搜索的情况下,Entropy-invariance rule=in(8,192)/ln(L)(Su, 2021)规则适用于Dense选择的一格内的两个武器地带,而YARN更严格的规则将混合的2-6%提前(附录C.10)。 支票上没有写哪个手臂更适合伸展 或哪个手臂是否使用最远的上下文 校准后,每桶损失不再随着上下文的累积而下降(附录C.3),在跨越文件边界的窗口上的复杂度是远距离使用的一种不敏感的衡量标准(Fang等人,2025年;限制)。

blocks.en: 5 Recommendations and conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 建议和结论

blocks.en: A training-time attention change evaluated beyond its training length should be compared with its baseline at calibrated temperatures as well as at the default, with a positive control and a stated resolution. This holds under the standard recipe: in our three standard-recipe pairs the 8k baseline is 8–15% miscalibrated at 30k, and in one of them this gave the changed model a 7% default-temperature advantage that calibration removed. The check costs one temperature sweep per model and evaluation length, or none with the entropy-invariance rule; for other changes the grid step and the positive control have to be chosen again. The second check is whether the normalisation gains moved. Under round-to-nearest bf16 without fp32 master weights they cannot move at any peak learning rate below about 1.7 × \times 10 -3 with β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.95 (2.7 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} with β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.999), and a one-line read of the checkpoint shows whether they did. A baseline with frozen gains has a 30k perplexity at τ \tau = 1 of 1.6–2.4 times its calibrated value, against which a sparse, dropout or ALiBi variant that tolerates the default temperature better appears to extrapolate; fp32 master weights ( Micikevicius et al., 2018 ) for the gains remove most of the effect.
blocks.zh: 培训时间的注意力变化超出培训时间,应与其在校准温度和默认情况下的基线进行比较,并有积极的控制和明确的决议。 这符合标准配方: 在我们的三对标准配方中, 8k 的基线是 8 - 15% 的 30k 的校准, 在其中之一中, 它赋予了 7% 的默认温度优势, 校准被取消了。 检查每个模型和评价长度需要一次温度扫荡,或者没有使用 en-偏振规则;对于其他改变格子步骤,必须再次选择正控. 第二个检查是正常化收益是否移动. 在无fp32主重的圆形至近bf16下,在任何峰值学习速率下,他们都无法移动,大约在1.7××××次以β2\βa_{2}=0.95(2.7×××次以β2\β10×4×4}=0.99,单行读出检查站是否如此. 含冻结增益的基线在\ tau = 1 等于 1.6–2.4 倍的校准值时有 30k 的模糊度, 相对而言, 能够较好地容忍默认温度的 稀疏、 淘汰 或 ALIBI 变体似乎可以推断; fp32 主重( Micikevicius 等人, 2018年) 对于收益来说, 消除了大部分效果。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Seed counts and scale. Six paired seeds at 365M and four pairs at 1.2B carry the frozen-gain result; the 3B pair, the regime pairs, the parameterisation ablations and the Dense-16k control are single pairs. The learnable-gain result has three pairs at each of 365M and 1.2B and the standard-recipe result three pairs at 365M only; the 3B twins were not retrained, so the growth of the frozen-gain effect with scale (§4.1) is documented under the frozen-gain recipe only, and the standard-recipe miscalibration is measured at one scale. Effects that appear larger at 1.2B and 3B conflate parameters with training tokens (7.2B/24.8B/49.2B) and with data repetition (1.98 passes at 3B, 1.00 at 1.2B, 0.29 at 365M). The ALiBi comparison has five frozen-gain pairs and two learnable-gain pairs; the four in-house control arms were run with frozen gains only.
blocks.zh: 种子数量和规模。 365M的6对种子和1.2B的4对种子承载着冷冻换成的结果;3B对,制度对,参数化调和Dense-16k控制是单对的. 可学习增益结果在365M和1.2B各有3对,标准减益结果只有365M;3B双胞胎没有再受训练,因此与尺度(§4.1)的冷冻增益效应的生长只记录在冰冻增益食谱下,标准减益误差以一个尺度衡量. 1.2B和3B的参数与训练标志(7.2B/24.8B/49.2B)和数据重复(3.98通过3B,1.00通过1.2B,0.29通过365M)相混合。 ALIBI比较有5对冷冻增益双和2对可学习增益双;4个内部控制武器只使用冷冻增益.

blocks.en: Calibration. Among the frozen-gain twins, temperature selection covers one seed at 365M and 3B and four at 1.2B; the six-seed 365M check applies seed 42’s temperatures without re-selecting them and is directional support only. The window-level intervals describe one pair on 36 windows, do not support seed-level inference, and treat windows cut from one token stream as independent, so autocorrelation would make them anti-conservative. The ± \pm 0.03 resolution is applied to every calibrated residual; residuals inside it are read from their sign consistency across seeds and windows, which for the 1.2B learnable-gain pairs favours Mixed in 3 of 3 seeds but in only 10–24 of 36 windows, and for the 365M learnable-gain and standard-recipe pairs is against Mixed or mixed. The NTK positive control’s calibrated gain is one to one and a half grid steps, so the procedure’s ability to preserve a genuine gain is shown near its own resolution. We did not tune per-layer, per-head, per-position or learned temperatures. ALiBi’s temperature rescales its content logits while its distance biases stay fixed, so the ALiBi comparison tests the RoPE baseline’s calibration rather than ALiBi’s own; a temperature on the full ALiBi score was not tried.
blocks.zh: 校对. 在冰冻的双胞胎中,温度选择包括一个种子,365M和3B;四个种子,1.2B;六种子365M检查应用了种子42的温度,而没有重新选择它们,只是方向支持. 窗口层间隔描述在36个窗口上一对,不支持种子层推论,并将从一个令牌流中切开的窗口视为独立,因此自动连接会使其具有抗保守性. ±\pm 0.03 分辨率适用于每个校准的残基;其残基从种子和窗口之间的标志一致性读取,对于1.2B可学习的对子有利 混合在3个种子中的3个种子中,但在36个窗口中的10至24个种子中,对365M的可学习-增益和标准的-再生对是反对混合或混合的。 NTK正控的校准收益是一到一个半网格步骤,因此程序保存真正收益的能力在自己的分辨率附近显示出来. 我们没有调和每层、每头、每个位置或学到的温度。 阿里比的温度在保持距离偏差的同时调整了内容记录,因此阿里比的比较测试了罗佩基线的校准,而不是阿里比自己的;完全阿里比分的温度没有尝试过。

blocks.en: Breadth. The study uses a single architecture family (a Qwen3-style configuration with RoPE base 10 6 10^{6} except for the two RoPE-10 4 regime pairs, a setting where softmax flattening with key count is expected and positional failure is mild), a single pretraining corpus, one training length for the twin pairs and one mask family. The two regime pairs show that the calibrated result changes with QK-normalisation and RoPE base, but they are single seeds, and the no-QK-norm pair selects the sharpest temperatures in the paper (0.70–0.75). Whether the effect persists with native long-context training, other data or other architectures is untested; the Dense-16k control (Table 2; Appendix C.8), trained on its 8k twin’s tokens in half the steps, did not improve on the twin and is not a clean positive control. Evaluation windows are contiguous slices of a concatenated token stream and can cross document boundaries; on FineWeb-Edu most of a 30k window is unrelated preceding text, so position-resolved results there may not measure long-range use, and we did not score the same targets with the distant context removed. Why the frozen scale costs Dense more than Mixed, and why the standard-recipe Dense is more miscalibrated beyond the span than the learnable-gain Dense, are not identified. The evidence comes from several evaluation runs on three clusters. Protocol keying and the cross-hardware floor (0.04% in perplexity, 0.0004 nats) are documented in Appendix B, but code revisions and example hashes were not recorded for every early result, the two ablation flags were run from an uncommitted working copy, and both arms of the 1.2B learnable-gain pairs were trained across interrupted launches resumed with full state.
blocks.zh: 饼. 研究采用单一的建筑家族(一种带有ROPE基础10 6 10^{6}的Quen3式配置,除了两个ROPE-10 4 个制度对,一个设置是按键计数的软马克斯平整,位置故障是轻微的),一个单预训,一个训练长的双对和一个面具家族. 两种制度配对显示,校准的结果随QK-正常化和ROPE基数而变化,但它们是单种种子,无QK-诺姆配对选择纸张中最尖锐的温度(0.70–0.75). 是否通过本土的长文培训、其他数据或其他结构来维持这种效果,还没有经过测试;Dense-16k控制(表2;附录C.8)在一半的步骤中接受了8k双胞胎的标志性训练,对双胞胎没有改善,也不是干净的正控。 评估窗口是折叠式符号流的毗连片段,可以跨越文档边界;在FineWeb-Edu上,30k窗口的大部分与前作文本无关,因此位置解析结果可能无法测量远程用途,我们没有在删除的远处上下文中得分相同的目标. 为何冻结的比额表成本 语气比混音还多,以及为什么标准-recippe Dense比可学习-增益的Dense在跨度以外更误判,没有被识别出来. 证据来自对三组评价。 附录B中记录了协议键盘和交叉硬件底片(0.04%的复杂度,0.0004纳特),但是没有记录每个早期结果的代码修改和例散列,两面缩写旗都从未承诺的工作副本中运行,1.2B可学习对子的两个臂部在中断的发射恢复完全状态时都接受了训练.

blocks.en: Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: The models are small base language models trained on a public web corpus (FineWeb-Edu) and evaluated on public corpora; no human subjects or annotation were involved and no personal data were collected (the public corpora may contain personal information present in their sources), and no model is released with capabilities beyond those of comparably sized public checkpoints. The study’s main cost is training compute: 25 Dense/Mixed pairs up to 3B parameters (six learnable-gain, three standard-recipe, two regime pairs and three parameterisation ablations), plus 29 control-arm models (seven of them ALiBi twins) and one Dense-16k model at 365M, trained data-parallel on A100 40 GB, A100 80 GB and H100 80 GB GPUs in allocations that varied by run, on three clusters. Per-run GPU-hours were not recorded by a scheduler; a 6ND estimate with the unique parameter counts gives 5.3 × 10 21 5.3\times 10^{21} training FLOPs for the models reported here (pilots, superseded and incomplete runs excluded), roughly 3,000–4,900 H100-hours or 9,400–15,600 A100-hours at 30–50% utilisation. The training and evaluation code is at https://github.com/rubentium/SparseAtt ; model checkpoints are not released.
blocks.zh: 这些模型是在公共网站(FineWeb-Edu)上培训的小型基本语言模型,并且对公共公司进行了评估;没有涉及人主体或注释,也没有收集任何个人数据(公共公司可能在其来源中包含个人信息),除了相当规模的公共检查站之外,没有发布任何能力模型。 研究的主要成本是训练计算:25个Dense/Mixed对最多可达3B参数(6个可学习增益,3个标准recipe,2个制度对和3个参数化模拟),加上29个控制臂模型(其中7个是Alibi双胞胎)和365M的一个Dense-16k模型,在A100 40 GB,A100 80 GB和H100 80 GB GPU的分量上经过训练的数据平行,分三组进行不同的分配. 每个运行的GPU小时没有被排程器记录;一个带有独特参数的6ND估计给出了5.3×10 21 5.3\time 10^{21}为这里报告的模型培训FLOP(飞行员,替换和不完全运行除外),大约3,000–4,900 H100小时或9,400–15,600 A100小时,使用率为30–50%. 培训和评价守则见https://github.com/rubentium/SparseAtt;示范检查站不放行。

blocks.en: Architecture. 365M: 359.0M unique parameters, hidden 768, 28 layers, 6 query and 2 KV heads, head dimension 128, MLP width 3,072. 1.2B: 1,202.4M parameters, hidden 1,536, 28 layers, 12 query and 4 KV heads, head dimension 128, MLP width 6,144. 3B: 3,004.4M parameters, hidden 2,304, 36 layers, 24 query and 8 KV heads, head dimension 128, MLP width 7,936. The input embedding and the output projection are tied ( tie_word_embeddings:true ; the 151,936 × \times d embedding is counted once). Normalisation layers compute x ^ = x / mean ⁡ ( x 2 ) + ϵ \hat{x}=x/\sqrt{\mathrm{mean}(x^{2})+\epsilon} and return x ^ ⋅ w \hat{x}\cdot w with w initialised to ones (not a 1 + w 1+w parameterisation). RoPE uses the rotate-half convention with base 10 6 10^{6} (10 4 in the base-10 4 regime pair).
blocks.zh: 架构. 365M:359.0M独有参数,隐藏768,28层,6个查询和2个KV头,头尺寸128,MLP宽3,072. 1.2B:1,202.4M参数,隐藏1,536,28层,12个查询和4个KV头,头尺寸128,MLP宽6,144. 3B:3,004.4M参数,隐藏2,304,36层,24个查询和8个KV头,头尺寸128,MLP宽度7,936. 输入嵌入和输出投影是绑定的(绑定_word_embeddings: true;151,936×\times d 嵌入计算一次). 正常化层计算 x ^ = x / 表示 ^ (x 2 ) + + \ hat{}\ x/\ sqrt\ mathrm{ MEAN} (x^{2})\\ epsilon} 并返回 x ^ ^ ^ w\ \ \ x}\cdot w , 并带有 w 禁用到 的 (不是 1 + w 1+w 参数化) 。 ROPE使用旋转半体的公约,其中基数为10 6 10^{6}(基数为10 4,基数为-10 4 制度对).

blocks.en: Optimisation. Fused AdamW with β 1 \beta_{1} = 0.9, β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.95 and ϵ \epsilon = 10 -8 , peak learning rate 5 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} , linear warm-up over 750 steps then cosine decay to zero, weight decay 0.01 applied to every parameter (no exclusion of biases or normalisation weights), gradient clipping 1.0. Global batch 20 sequences at 365M and 60 at 1.2B and 3B, held fixed by gradient accumulation when the number of GPUs changed. A lower learning rate (3 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) was held in reserve for unstable runs and was not needed. Training is data-parallel in PyTorch ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) ; the Mixed arm uses FlexAttention ( Dong et al., 2024 ) block masks on the compiled block-sparse path. Twins sharing a seed see the same training sequences in the same order: the training code resets the data RNG so that the data order is fixed by the seed, and the mask sampler draws from a separate stream. Runs were checkpointed and resumed whenever the allocation changed, with optimiser, scheduler, data-loader and RNG state restored and the scheduled learning rate preserved.
blocks.zh: 优化。 骗了亚当 W与β 1\β1}=0.9,β 2\β2\β2}=0.95和\epsilon = 10-8,峰值学习率 5×\时 10− 4 10× 4},线性暖化750步以上,然后余弦衰减至0,重量衰减0.01适用于每个参数(不排除偏差或正常化权重),梯度剪切1.0. 全局批量20个序列在365M,60个序列在1.2B和3B,在GPU数量变化时由梯度累积固定. 较低的学习率(3×时 10− 4 10× 4})被保留用于不稳定运行,不需要. 训练在PyTorch(Paszke等人,2019年)中是数据平行的;混合臂在编译的块-sparse路径上使用FlexAtenty(Dong等人,2024年)块口罩. 分享种子的双胞胎以相同的顺序看到相同的训练序列:训练代码重置数据RNG,以便数据顺序由种子固定,面具采样者从单独的流中抽取. 每当分配改变时,检查并恢复运行,恢复Opimiser、调度器、数据装载器和RNG状态,并保留预定的学习率。

blocks.en: Precision recipes. Canonical (pure bf16): every parameter, including the residual-stream RMSNorm and QK-normalisation gains, is stored and updated in bf16 with bf16 optimiser state and no fp32 master copy; every normalisation gain stays exactly at 1.0 (Appendix B). Learnable QK gains : the 56 q_norm / k_norm gain tensors are kept as fp32 master weights with fp32 AdamW moments and cast to bf16 inside the forward pass (training flag qk_gain_fp32 ); every other parameter keeps the canonical precision (checkpoints hold 56 fp32 and 255 bf16 tensors; the residual RMSNorm gains remain bf16 and frozen at 1.0). This recipe was trained at 365M for seeds 42–44 and at 1.2B for seeds 70–72 (run identifiers FINAL_20260924 , FINAL3_20260927 and FINAL5_20261014 in the released archive). Standard recipe : fp32 master weights and fp32 AdamW state for every parameter, bf16 autocast compute, round-to-nearest, no stochastic rounding (all 311 tensors fp32 in the checkpoint). It was trained at 365M for seeds 41–43 (run identifier FINAL6_20261020/21 ). Two further single seed-42 parameterisations: all-norm keeps all 113 normalisation-gain tensors (56 Q/K, 56 residual RMSNorm, final norm) as fp32 master weights (113 fp32 and 198 bf16 tensors); scalar leaves every gain vector canonical (bf16, 1.0, frozen) and adds one learnable fp32 scalar per Q/K norm module (56 scalars, initialised 1.0, same learning rate and weight decay) that multiplies the normalised queries, respectively keys. On checkpoints with learned gains the temperature divides the learned fp32 q_norm gain by τ \tau from an unmodified fp32 copy; for the scalar pair it scales the queries by 1/ τ \tau (an exact fp32 attention scale), because dividing the bf16-cast scalar realises τ \tau only to bf16 precision; the two paths agree exactly on a QK-norm checkpoint (Appendix B).
blocks.zh: 精密的食谱. Canonical(纯bf16):每个参数,包括残余流RMSNorm和QK-正常化增益,都以bf16存储和更新,具有bf16的Opimiser状态,没有fp32的主复制;每个正常化增益完全停留在1.0(附录B). 可学习的QK增益:56 q_norm / k_norm增益分数以fp32 AdamW瞬间作为fp32主重数保存,并投放到前方通行证内的bf16(训练旗 qk_gain_fp32);所有其他参数都保持犬形精度(检查点保持56 fp32和255 bf16 升数;剩余RMSNorm增益保持bf16并冻结在1.0). 这种食谱在365M接受42-44种子的培训,在1.2B接受70-72种子的培训(在已发布的档案中运行的识别符Finally_20260924,Finance3_20260927和Finance5_20261014)。 标准食谱:fp32主重和fp32 AdamW状态,每个参数,bf16自动播报计算,圆至近,不进行切变圆形圆形(检查站所有311个百分位数fp32). 它在365M接受41-43(运行识别码Finally6_20261020/21 )种子训练. 另外两个单一的种子-42参数:全规范将所有113个常态增益的百分数(56 Q/K,56 残基 RMSNorm,最终规范)作为fp32主重(113 fp32和198 bf16 百分数);scalar留下每个增益的矢量卡(bf16,1.0,冷冻),并每个Q/K规范模块增加一个可学习的fp32分数(56 scalars, uncild 1.0,相同的学习速率和重量衰减),分别将常态查询乘以键. 在有学习成绩的检查站,温度将所学的fp32 q_norm增益与未经修改的fp32副本区分开来;对于scalar配对,它将查询量比为1/\tau(一个精确的fp32注意度尺度),因为将bf16-cast的scalaral实现量只分为bf16精度;两条路径完全商定QK-norm检查站(附录B)。

blocks.en: Mixed-arm masks. Block size 128; a pool of 10,000 pre-generated causal block masks ( sparse_mask_pool_size=10000 ); each pool mask draws its budget k uniformly from {63, 47, 31, 21, 11} of 64 blocks at the 8,192-token training length (budgets 98%, 73%, 48%, 33%, 17%; mean ≈ \approx 54%). At every training step each attention layer selects one pool entry uniformly at random, independently of the other layers, and applies it to every sequence in the batch. A query block’s own (diagonal) block is always retained through the local causal path; the remaining retained blocks are sampled uniformly from the non-diagonal blocks and blocks in the future of the query block are removed by causality, so early query blocks have fewer than k retained predecessors and block 0 is retained only when sampled. The Dense arm uses full causal attention. The mask is the only difference between arms.
blocks.zh: 混合枪口罩。 区块尺寸128; 预先生成的1万个因果区块口罩(稀有的_mask_pool_size = 10000); 每个区块口罩从64个区块中的{63, 47, 31, 21, 11} 统一抽取其预算k, 时间长度为8,192个(预算为98%, 73%, 48%, 33%, 17%; 平均值为\\ 大约 54%)。 在每一个训练步骤中,每个注意力层都随机统一选择一个集合条目,独立于其他各层,并将其应用于批次中的每一个序列. 一个查询块自己的(diagonal)块总是通过局部的因果路径保留;剩下的保留块从非对角块中被统一采样,在查询块的未来的块被因果去除,因此早期的查询块保留前身少于k,只有在采样时才保留第0块. Dense臂部使用充分的因果注意. 面具是两臂的唯一区别.

blocks.en: Control arms (365M, canonical recipe). The Static and Resampled controls fix k = 35 of 64 (55%, the mean Mixed budget; checkpoint tag nrb35 ): Static uses a one-entry mask pool (one fixed mask throughout training) and Resampled a 10,000-entry pool of k = 35 masks; seeds 42–47. The attention-dropout control uses p = 0.28 (seeds 42–46). The scalar RoPE-distance control (checkpoint tag ropectl_a1p0 , scalar parameter a = 1.0) is a Dense model trained with a single scalar modification of the RoPE distance term, built to test whether a one-parameter positional change reproduces Mixed’s behaviour (seeds 42–46). The ALiBi control ( ALIBI_20260921 ; seeds 42–46) replaces RoPE by head-specific linear distance biases with slopes 2ˆ( − - 8h/n_q) for query head h of n_q = 6 ( Press et al., 2022 ) , keeps QK-normalisation and every other setting of the 365M Dense recipe, and uses the Dense twin’s data seed and order; the bias is added to the scaled content logit, so the temperature rescales the content term only. The learnable-gain ALiBi arms ( FINAL7_20261023 ; seeds 42, 43) add qk_gain_fp32 to that recipe and are paired with the FINAL_20260924 learnable-gain Dense of the same seed. The two regime pairs ( REGIME_20260922 ; seed 42, Dense and Mixed both retrained) change one setting of the 365M recipe: the no-QK-norm pair removes the q_norm / k_norm modules; the RoPE-10 4 pair sets the rotary base to 10 4 . The Dense-16k control uses the learnable-gain Dense recipe at sequence length 16,384 for 22,000 steps at a global batch of 20 × \times 16,384 tokens, i.e. the same 7.21B training tokens as the 8k runs. With the loader option concatenate_seeded_8k , 16k sequence i is the concatenation of 8k sequences 2 i and 2 i +1 in the seed-42 order, so the control sees exactly the tokens of its 8k twin, in half as many optimiser steps with twice as many tokens per step.
blocks.zh: 控制武器(365M,犬类食谱)。 静态和复苏控制固定k=35 = 64(55%,平均混合预算;检查站标记nrb35): 静态使用一个单进式口罩池(整个训练过程中有一个固定口罩),并恢复了一个10000进式口罩池k=35个口罩;种子42-47. 注意放出控制使用p=0.28(种子42-46)。 scalar RoPE-距离控制(checkpoint tag rotectl_a1p0,scalar 参数a = 1.0)是一款经过单倍径修改的Dense模型,用于测试单参数位置变化是否复制Mixd的行为(种子42-46). ALIBI控制(ALIBI_20260921;种子42-46)用斜率2ˆ(−−-8h/n_q)取代ROPE,用于n_q=6的查询头h(Press等人,2022年),保持QK-正常化以及365M Dense食谱的所有其他设置,并使用Dense双子的数据种子和顺序;偏差被添加到缩放内容对数中,因此温度只调整内容名词. 可学习的ALIBI臂(最后7_20261023;种子42,43)在配方中加入qk_gain_fp32,并与最终_20260924可学习的对称. 同一种子的阴森。 两对制度配对(REGIME_20260922;种子42,Dense和Mixed均重新训练)更改了365M配方的一个设置: 无QK-norm配对去除q_norm / k_norm模块;RoPE-10 4配对将旋转底座设置为10 4. Dense-16k控制器采用可学习-增益的Dense配方,序列长度为16,384,为22,000步,在全球批量为20×\时16,384个符,即与8k运行时相同的7.21B训练符. 用加载器选项concatenate_seed_8k,16k序列i是8k序列2i和2i+1在种子-42顺序中的交配,因此控制器完全看到了其8k双胞胎的代号,在选择步骤中以每步2倍的代号为一半.

blocks.en: Data and licences. All models are pretrained on a local export of FineWeb-Edu sample-100BT ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) : 3,027,764 training sequences of 8,192 tokens (24.80B tokens; a deterministic 95/5 split leaves 159,356 validation sequences). At the recorded step counts the 365M, 1.2B and 3B runs consume 7.21B, 24.80B and 49.15B tokens, i.e. 0.29, 1.00 and 1.98 passes over the training split. Evaluation corpora: FineWeb-Edu validation windows from the same export; PG-19 ( Rae et al., 2020 ; Apache 2.0); arXiv from the Common Pile release common-pile/arxiv_papers ( Kandpal et al., 2025 ; openly licensed papers processed from their LaTeX sources). FineWeb-Edu is released under ODC-By 1.0 and the Qwen3 tokeniser under Apache 2.0. The evaluation windows were exported as fixed token arrays (96 windows of 8,192 and 24 of 30,720 tokens per corpus, two export copies); the export records neither document identifiers nor a pinned dataset revision, so the exact source documents are not recoverable from the window files. All training and evaluation text is English; the corpora are used unmodified for perplexity scoring only and nothing is redistributed.
blocks.zh: 数据和许可证。 所有型号在FineWeb-Edu样本-100BT(Penedo等人,2024年)的本地出口上都预训过:3,027,764个训练序列共8,192个令牌(24.80B令牌;定型95/5分型叶159,356个验证序列). 在记录的步数中,365M、1.2B和3B的运行消耗了7.21B、24.80B和49.15B的标志,即0.29、1.00和1.98通过培训分期。 评价机构: FineWeb-Edu验证窗口来自同一出口;PG-19(Rae等人,2020年;Apache 2.0);ArXiv来自Common Pile发行的普通纸/arxiv_papers(Kandpal等人,2025年;从其LaTeX来源处理的公开许可文件)。 FineWeb-Edu在ODC-By 1.0下发布,在Apache 2.0下发布Quen3 sorderiser. 评价窗口作为固定的代号数组(每件8,192个的96个窗口和30,720个代号中的24个窗口,2个导出副本)输出;出口记录既没有文件标识符,也没有绑定数据集修订,因此准确的源文件无法从窗口文件中收回. 所有训练和评价文本均为英文;公司版仅用于迷惑性评分,不作重新分配。

blocks.zh: 附录B 评价协议, AdamW/bf16约束和来源

blocks.en: Windows. The temperature protocol uses disjoint calibration and held-out sets of equal size: 8, 4, 2 and 2 non-overlapping windows per corpus at 8k, 16k, 24k and 30k (65,528, 65,532, 49,150 and 61,438 tokens per set). Every calibrated 24k and 30k result therefore uses two held-out windows per corpus, six per pair. The 36-window set adds ten further held-out windows per corpus at 24k and 30k, disjoint from every calibration window; it was evaluated in run RESOLUTION_20260921 (file RESOLUTION_20260921_driftfree_all_rows.tsv , the re-run with hash-verified window manifests, which supersedes RESOLUTION_20260921_all_rows.tsv ). The later runs’ 30k position-resolved (diagnostics) windows, eight per corpus, include the two calibration and the two held-out windows, so their calibrated position profiles are partly in-sample and are reported as diagnostics; the canonical pairs’ calibrated profiles (Tables C.3a–C.3b) use the two held-out windows. The default-temperature diagnostics of §4.1 (Table C.1a; Fig. 2a, solid) use 24, 12, 8 and 8 windows per corpus. blocks.en: Calibration and statistics. τ ∗ \tau^{*} is the arg-min over the 13-point grid of the summed NLL over the calibration windows of the three corpora, per model and length, and is applied to the held-out windows. Twins sharing a seed are paired and the seed is the unit of analysis; cells report the mean paired Δ \Delta , its SD across seeds and the number of seeds favouring the change; exact two-sided sign-flip p-values are in the supplementary tables (their 0.031 floor at six seeds restates a 6/6 count). On the 36-window set we report the mean paired difference with a 95% t-half-width and the number of windows favouring the change; these characterise one pair and treat windows cut from one token stream as independent. Seed-level 90% two-one-sided-test (TOST) intervals of the calibrated 30k residual (Appendix C.2) lie within the margin if and only if both one-sided tests reject at the 5% level.

blocks.en: The AdamW/bf16 bound. The bf16 spacing is 2 − 7 ≈ 0.0078 2^{-7}\approx 0.0078 just above 1.0 and 2 − 8 2^{-8} just below, so under round-to-nearest an update smaller than 0.002 (downward) or 0.004 (upward) leaves a value of exactly 1.0 unchanged. With β 1 \beta_{1} = 0.9 and β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.95 the bias-corrected moment ratio of Adam ( Kingma and Ba, 2015 ) is bounded for every gradient sequence by (1 − β 1 -\beta_{1} )/ √ \surd ((1 − β 2 -\beta_{2} )(1 − β 1 2 -\beta_{1}^{2} / β 2 \beta_{2} )) ≈ \approx 1.165 (Cauchy–Schwarz over the two exponential averages); the unit bound sometimes quoted for this case does not hold in general. A step is therefore at most 1.17 × \times 5 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} ≈ \approx 5.8 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} at the peak learning rate, plus a decoupled weight-decay term of 5 × \times 10 -6 . Rounding the moments themselves to bf16 changes the ratio by under 1%. For β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.98, 0.99 and 0.999 the same bound is 1.70, 2.35 and 7.27, so a bf16 gain at 1.0 cannot move at peak learning rates below 1.15 × \times 10 -3 , 8.3 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} and 2.7 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} respectively (1.68 × \times 10 -3 at β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.95). Every possible update here is therefore below the 1.95 × \times 10 -3 needed to move a bf16 value downward off 1.0, and a parameter initialised at exactly 1.0 and stored in bf16 is frozen for the whole run. The effect is identical in both arms and does not disturb the pairing. A CPU audit of the canonical 365M Dense seed-42 checkpoint confirms it: all 113 normalisation-gain tensors are stored in bf16 and every element is exactly 1.0; the 56 Q/K-norm tensors carry non-zero AdamW first and second moments at optimiser step 44,000. In every one of the 22 canonical checkpoints (365M seeds 42–47, 1.2B seeds 42 and 70–72, 3B seed 42) every stored QK-normalisation gain value is exactly 1.0.

blocks.en: Provenance and reproducibility. The canonical cells were produced on the first cluster (A100 40/80 GB) and keyed by protocol (tier, length, split, corpus, window set, temperature, evaluator); 55 entries evaluated in more than one run agree to within 0.024% relative perplexity, and no differing values were averaged. Models trained after the first allocation ended (the 1.2B learnable-gain pairs, the ablations, the Dense-16k control, the standard-recipe pairs and the learnable-gain ALiBi arms) were evaluated on two further clusters (H100 80 GB; A100 for one recheck) with the same evaluator revision and the same window manifests (verified by hash). Before each later run produced new results, the evaluator re-scored frozen canonical checkpoints on the new hardware. On the same hardware class the 1.2B seed-70 cells reproduced to within 5 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} %. The per-corpus 30k calibration-window cells of the frozen references reproduced to within 0.02% (seed 71 on H100: twelve cells, maximum 0.018%; seed 72 on A100 40 GB, the first cluster’s hardware class: twelve cells, 0.020%), and the ALiBi seed-42 reference cells to within 0.020%. The 24 frozen-baseline cells assembled before the standard-recipe run agree with the first-cluster values to within 0.04% (maximum 0.038% on one FineWeb-Edu cell; 17 of the 18 cells with a first-cluster reference within 0.03%; the frozen Mixed seed-43 arm had not been evaluated under the dense protocol on the first cluster); the twelve seed-42 cells among them coincide exactly with the first cluster’s drift-free re-scoring and so add no independent cross-hardware measurement. An A100 recheck of the seed-71 cells reproduced the first-cluster values exactly, consistent with a numerical-path effect (reduction order under bf16/TF32) rather than an evaluator defect, although the seed-72 check on the first cluster’s hardware class still differed by up to 0.020%. The largest such discrepancy among the canonical reference cells, 0.04% in perplexity, is 0.0004 nats against the 0.03 log-PPL resolution of §3.2. Both arms of each later pair were evaluated on the same hardware, so paired differences carry no cross-hardware term. The 1.2B learnable-gain pairs were trained across several interrupted launches, each resumed from the last checkpoint with full state (the seed-70 Dense arm across two clusters); the two ablation flags ( norm_gain_fp32 , qk_gain_mode ) were run from an uncommitted working copy of the training revision and their configuration hashes, not a commit, identify the code; the standard-recipe and learnable-gain ALiBi runs record their training commit. Exact package versions were not recorded alongside the result files; the released evaluation code names the packages it imports.
